cards.ex: The fragrant aroma of jasmine filled the entire garden.
cards.exUz: Yaseminning xushbo'y hidi butun bog'ni to'ldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yoqimli va kuchli hid, ko'pincha gullar yoki ovqatdan keladi.

cards.ex: The pungent smell of garlic lingered in the kitchen for hours.
cards.exUz: Sarimsoqning o'tkir hidi oshxonada soatlab saqlanib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va ko'pincha yoqimsiz hid.

cards.ex: His story smells fishy; I don't believe a word he says.
cards.exUz: Uning hikoyasi shubhali; men uning birorta so'ziga ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir to'g'ri emasdek tuyulishi, shubhali ko'rinishi.

cards.ex: There's a bittersweet taste to success after so much struggle.
cards.exUz: Ko'p kurashlardan keyin muvaffaqiyatning achchiq-shirin ta'mi bor.
cards.uzDef: Bir vaqtning o'zida ham achchiq, ham shirin bo'lgan ta'm.

cards.ex: This soup has a bland flavor; it needs more seasoning.
cards.exUz: Bu sho'rva ta'msiz; unga ko'proq ziravorlar kerak.
cards.uzDef: Deyarli ta'mi yo'q, hech qanday o'ziga xos ta'mga ega bo'lmagan.

cards.ex: The chef created a dish specifically designed to tantalize the taste buds.
cards.exUz: Oshpaz aynan ta'mni qo'zg'atish uchun mo'ljallangan taom yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Ajoyib ta'mi bilan kishining ishtahasini ochmoq.

cards.ex: My gut reaction was to say no, even though I didn't have a reason.
cards.exUz: Mening ichki sezgim yo'q deyish edi, garchi menda sabab bo'lmasa ham.
cards.uzDef: Aqliy tahlilga asoslanmagan, instinktiv reaksiya.

cards.ex: She comforted the crying child with a tender touch.
cards.exUz: U yig'layotgan bolani mayin tegish bilan ovutdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ta ehtiyotkorlik va sevgini ifodalovchi tegish.

cards.ex: Hold on tight and keep a firm grip on the railing.
cards.exUz: Mahkam ushlang va to'siqni qattiq ushlab turing.
cards.uzDef: Narsani mahkam ushlab turish, qo'yib yubormaslik.

cards.ex: The comedian has a light touch, making even serious topics funny.
cards.exUz: Komik engil yondashuvga ega, hatto jiddiy mavzularni ham kulguli qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ehtiyotkorlik va noziklik bilan yondashish.

cards.ex: I have a sweet tooth, so I always crave dessert after dinner.
cards.exUz: Menda shirinlikka o'chlik bor, shuning uchun men har doim kechki ovqatdan keyin desertga intilaman.
cards.uzDef: Shirinliklarni juda yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: The argument put a sour note on what had been a pleasant evening.
cards.exUz: Bahs yoqimli kechani buzdi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi vaziyatni buzadigan noxush element.

cards.ex: I could smell trouble brewing when the boss called us into his office.
cards.exUz: Boshlig'imiz bizni o'z ofisiga chaqirganda, muammo paydo bo'lishini sezdim.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki xavf paydo bo'lishini sezmoq.

cards.ex: The way he handled the situation left a bad taste in everyone's mouth.
cards.exUz: Uning vaziyatni hal qilishi hammada yoqimsiz taassurot qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Unutilmas yoqimsiz his-tuyg'ularni qoldirish.

cards.ex: Even after she left, a lingering scent of her perfume remained in the room.
cards.exUz: U ketganidan keyin ham, uning atirining uzoqlashmaydigan hidi xonada qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida saqlanib qoladigan hid.

cards.ex: This tea has a delicate flavor with hints of citrus.
cards.exUz: Bu choyda sitrus mevalarining nozik ta'mi bor.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli bo'lmagan, ammo yoqimli va murakkab ta'm.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the project's progress.
cards.exUz: Loyiha rivojlanishini muhokama qilish uchun kelasi hafta aloqaga chiqaylik.
cards.uzDef: Qisqacha aloqaga chiqish, xabar almashish.

cards.ex: Keep the remote control within reach so I can change the channel.
cards.exUz: Pultni qo'l yetadigan joyda saqlang, men kanalni o'zgartirishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yaqin va osonlik bilan erishish mumkin bo'lgan.

cards.ex: He's so out of touch with current music trends.
cards.exUz: U zamonaviy musiqa tendentsiyalari bilan aloqasi yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Zamonaviy tendentsiyalar yoki odamlar bilan aloqasi yo'q.

cards.ex: The nurse had a soothing touch that calmed the patient.
cards.exUz: Hamshiraning tinchlantiruvchi tegishi bemorni tinchlantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Asabiylikni bosadigan, tinchlantiradigan tegish.

cards.ex: We're going through a rough patch financially, but we'll get through it.
cards.exUz: Biz moliyaviy jihatdan qiyin davrni boshdan kechirmoqdamiz, ammo biz undan o'tamiz.
cards.uzDef: Hayotda qiyin yoki omadsiz davr.

cards.ex: The chili has a spicy kick that warms you from the inside out.
cards.exUz: Chili achchiq ta'sirga ega bo'lib, sizni ichkaridan isitadi.
cards.uzDef: Achchiq ta'm beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: Sometimes I get a metallic taste in my mouth after taking medication.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan dori ichgandan keyin og'zimda metall ta'mi paydo bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Metallga o'xshash ta'm.

cards.ex: The old house had a musty smell, like it hadn't been opened in years.
cards.exUz: Eski uyning dimlangan hidi bor edi, go'yo u yillar davomida ochilmagandek.
cards.uzDef: Eski va nam joylarda paydo bo'ladigan yoqimsiz hid.

cards.ex: With this candy, you can truly taste the rainbow with all its different flavors.
cards.exUz: Ushbu konfet bilan siz barcha turli xil ta'mlari bilan haqiqatan ham xilma-xil ta'mlardan bahramand bo'lishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Xilma-xil ta'mlardan bahramand bo'lish.

cards.ex: The news of his death was a real gut punch.
cards.exUz: Uning o'limi haqidagi xabar haqiqiy qattiq zarba edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan va qattiq zarba, ko'pincha hissiy.

cards.ex: The lotion left my skin with a silky feel.
cards.exUz: Loson terimni ipakdek silliq qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ipak kabi silliq va yoqimli teginish.

cards.ex: Be careful; the table has a rough surface and might snag your clothes.
cards.exUz: Ehtiyot bo'ling; stolning sirti qo'pol va kiyimlaringizga ilashib qolishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tekis bo'lmagan, qo'pol sirt.

cards.ex: She has a nose for good investments.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi investitsiyalarga sezgir.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir tabiiy qobiliyatga ega bo'lmoq, sezgir bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The reporter had a nose for news and always got the best stories.
cards.exUz: Reportyorning yangiliklarga sezgirligi bor edi va har doim eng yaxshi hikoyalarni olar edi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim yangiliklarni aniqlash qobiliyati.
